title: A-site cation engineering and halide tuning via precursor engineering to tune the optical properties of 2D perovskites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28181-28190
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03422A, Paper
Open Access

Susana Ramos-Terrón, Cristina Martín, Gustavo de Miguel, Eduardo Solano, Daniel Hermida-Merino, Joris Van de Vondel, Johan Hofkens, Masoumeh Keshavarz
The optical properties of the metal halide perovskites (MHPs) have been modulated by replacing the typical A-site cations or, alternatively, by using different halides (I, Br or Cl) in the chemical composition.
